rules.rule_context: Politically exposed persons (PEPs) are individuals who hold or have held a prominent public function in a foreign or domestic government, including senior officials, ministers, deputy ministers, central bank officers, and senior executives of state-owned enterprises. Family members and close associates of PEPs are treated as PEPs themselves for onboarding purposes. Any account applicant matching a PEP screen is in scope for enhanced due diligence (EDD) prior to account opening. EDD for PEPs includes source of funds and source of wealth verification, additional identity and background documentation, and senior compliance approval to clear the file. Standard CIP alone does not satisfy EDD. The EDD package is a precondition to opening, not a post-opening remediation item. A prior PEP status, including foreign government service that ended in a past year, does not remove the individual from scope; the EDD obligation applies based on the historical position held.
